_meta.purpose: Cascading dropdown data for the physician tax calculator. When a state is selected, populate the city field from that state's cities array. States not listed here have NO local income tax, so hide or disable the city field for them.
_meta.source: Tax Foundation 2026, ITEP, state and city revenue departments. Rates are physician-level (high earner) approximations. Verify against current city schedules before publishing, and keep the 'illustration only, consult a tax professional' disclaimer.
_meta.rate_format: Decimal share of income (0.024 = 2.4%). Add this to the state rate to get the physician's total escaped rate when moving to Florida.

special_cases.graduated_income: Rate is the top marginal local rate; a physician's effective rate is slightly lower. Fine as an approximation at physician income.
special_cases.surcharge_of_state_tax: Not a percent of income. It is a percent of the state tax owed. Use surchargeRate against computed state tax, or the listed physicianLocalRate as a rough income-equivalent.
special_cases.graduated_regional: Applies only above income thresholds, so the flat rate overstates for lower incomes. physicianLocalRate is an effective estimate for a $400K to $600K earner.

NY.name: New York City
NY.note: Resident tax, graduated 3.078% to 3.876%. Physician marginal about 3.876%.

NY.name: Yonkers
NY.note: 16.75% of your New York state tax. About 1.1% of income for a physician.

NY.name: Rest of New York (no city tax)

MD.name: Baltimore City
MD.note: Maryland local tax is county-based and unavoidable. Range statewide is 2.25% to 3.20%.

MD.name: Other Maryland county
MD.note: Confirm the exact county rate, 2.25% to 3.20%.

OH.name: Other Ohio municipality
OH.note: Range 0.5% to 3%. Confirm the specific city.

PA.name: Philadelphia
PA.note: Resident wage tax. Confirm current rate, it declines gradually.

PA.name: Other Pennsylvania municipality
PA.note: Local Earned Income Tax, typically about 1%.

KY.name: Other Kentucky locality
KY.note: Varies widely by city and county.

OR.name: Portland (Multnomah County / Metro)
OR.note: Metro 1% over $125K plus Multnomah 1.5% over $125K and another 1.5% over $250K. Marginal reaches about 4% over $250K; 2.5% is an effective estimate for a $400K to $600K earner.

OR.name: Rest of Oregon (no local income tax)

IN.name: Other Indiana county
IN.note: Range 0.5% to over 3%. Confirm the county.

AL.name: Other Alabama locality
AL.note: A handful of cities levy an occupational tax.

_note: Keyed by USPS postal code (matches the calculator TAX table and savings-data.json). Cities: physicianLocalRate is a decimal; type 'surcharge_of_state_tax' means surchargeRate applies to state tax.
